note: Attacker-controlled image bytes are read into the in-memory 4096-byte APFS block buffer (_storage).

The btree table-of-contents offset is computed directly from the on-disk, unvalidated 16-bit table_space_offset; the crafted FSTREE node sets it to 0xFFFF, yielding a pointer 0x10037 bytes past the block start.
The table-of-contents pointer is stored as block base plus the unvalidated toffset(), so toc points far outside the block buffer.
tsk_fs_fls -> dir_open_meta -> file_open_meta -> APFSJObjTree::obj -> jobjs -> find_range -> find() iterates keys of the fuzzer-controlled FSTREE btree node, invoking key() on the crafted node.
Dereferencing the wild toc pointer performs the unknown read; the crash surfaces in the memory_view-returning key() (std::__1::enable_if<true, memory_view>::type).
